config_files.~/.vibe/config.toml:
active_model = "verity-model"
default_agent = "auto-approve"
enable_auto_update = false
enable_notifications = false
enable_telemetry = false

[[providers]]
name = "verity"
api_base = "{proxy_url}"
api_key_env_var = "VERITY_PROXY_KEY"
api_style = "openai"
backend = "generic"

[[models]]
name = "{model}"
provider = "verity"
alias = "verity-model"

[[mcp_servers]]
name = "lean-lsp"
transport = "stdio"
command = "uvx"
args = ["--from", "lean-lsp-mcp==0.28.0", "lean-lsp-mcp"]
startup_timeout_sec = 180
tool_timeout_sec = 600
env = { LEAN_PROJECT_PATH = "{workspace}", LEAN_LOG_LEVEL = "NONE", LEAN_BUILD_CONCURRENCY = "share", LEAN_MCP_DISABLED_TOOLS = "lean_run_code,lean_profile_proof,lean_minimal_hypotheses,lean_get_widgets,lean_get_widget_source,lean_leansearch,lean_loogle,lean_leanfinder,lean_state_search,lean_hammer_premise,lean_build" }
